ops.title: Honor CLI subprocess first-byte timeout portably
ops.description: Owner: /root/codex125_release_install. Source60f CLIProcessTransport stores timeout80 but readBytes never checks it and inherits no-op Transport.setTimeout. Root chose separate unresolved issue; do not block confirmed read1 repair or installedA/B. Existing named-pipe OVERLAPPED wait is not a Popen anonymous-pipe primitive. Python select supports Unix pipes but Windows sockets only; communicate changes lifecycle. Next: source-review a portable existing timed-pipe primitive or explicitly bounded platform design before implementing; no new threads/framework/global signals now. Original622 cause UNKNOWN.

ops.text: Bind constructor and setTimeout semantics plus a source-reviewed portable timed anonymous-pipe mechanism; document platform options without changing child lifecycle.
Actual CI silent-child regression demonstrates old missing timeout and candidate SocketTimeout while child remains owned and cleanup completes; partial-frame and buffer controls remain valid.
Normal source delivery records supported platforms and test-only scope; no original622 cause, native rebuild or host service fix claimed.
